[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 75
- Description: Research: satellite resolution/cadence cost + sponsor financing report
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1026
  
  Details:
  Research and cost analysis for increasing the resolution and cadence of the SunMint satellite view (Telegram thread 26145), plus a sponsor-ready pricing report for a project sponsor considering financing it.
  
  WHAT WAS DONE
  1. Baseline audit of the current pipeline: sunmint/scripts/cache_satellite_scenes.py uses Sentinel-2 L2A via Earth Search STAC (anonymous, free), daily cron 06:30 UTC, MAX_SCENES_PER_CELL=4, DAYS_BACK=45, GRID_DEG=0.01 (~1 km cells). Cache = 5 tree cells + 21 plot dirs, 104 scenes, 4.4 MB.
  2. Established that the cached asset is preview.jpg at 343x343 px, while a full TCI.tif tile is 241 MB — the app deliberately shows low-res renders.
  3. Separated the two independent levers (resolution vs cadence) and mapped free vs paid moves for each.
  4. Priced every viable option: Copernicus Data Space / Sentinel Hub (free 10,000 PU/month tier), Sentinel-1 SAR + Landsat 8/9 (free), Planet Agriculture per-hectare tiers ($1.80 / $0.85 / $0.35 per ha/yr, 500 ha minimum), Planet Monitoring area-under-management tiers, Planet Tropical Forest Observatory (successor to the ended NICFI program), Planet Nonprofit Program, and SkySat 50 cm tasking (~$1,212/km2, 25 km2 min, ~$30k per collect).
  5. Scaled cost to the 10,000-hectare mission target: ~$3,500/yr (cheapest tier) to ~$18,000/yr (top tier).
  6. Defect identified: Esri World Imagery returns a blank tile at zoom 18+ over the pilot plots (2,521 bytes vs 17,267 bytes for San Francisco at the same zoom), so the basemap goes empty exactly at the zoom needed to inspect canopies.
  7. Produced a 3-page sponsor-ready PDF cost report.
  
  DELIVERABLES
  - PR (merged): https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1026
  - Report markdown: docs/reports/SATELLITE_RESOLUTION_CADENCE_COST_RESEARCH.md
  - Sponsor PDF: docs/reports/satellite_resolution_cadence_cost_report_20260911.pdf
  
  CONTRIBUTORS AND TIME
  - Sophia Truesight (~60 min): source/STAC/cache audit, web pricing research, report + PDF production
  - Gary Teh (~15 min): raised the question, framed the sponsor-financing angle, guidance
  - Total logged: 75 minutes
  
  CAVEAT
  Planet's pricing page is bot-blocked; per-hectare and AUM figures are search-derived and indicative, not quoted. A formal sales quote is required for a firm number.
